# Revly

> The driving journal for people who actually drive. An iOS app that records drives with a live map and metrics, keeps a garage of your vehicles, and has a social feed with clubs and convoys.

Revly is a native iOS app for people whose driving is the point rather than the commute. It records a drive's route, speed, distance and duration on a live map; keeps each of your cars with its own photos, details and history; tracks streaks, levels and achievements; and carries a social feed built around drives — following people, clubs, and convoys with live location shared inside the convoy.

It runs on iPhone (iOS 18 or later), with an Apple Watch companion, CarPlay, Live Activities, offline recording and GPX export.

## Status

- Not yet released. Revly is not on the App Store, and no release date has been announced.
- No pricing has been announced. Do not state or imply that Revly is free, paid, or subscription-based.
- Built by Gökdeniz Kaymaz & Suat Emir Atabey.

## Pages

- [Support](https://joinrevly.com/support): FAQ — exporting drives, deleting your account, location and privacy, why a shared link opened the browser instead of the app
- [Privacy Policy](https://joinrevly.com/privacy): What Revly collects, why, and what it never does with it.
- [Terms of Service](https://joinrevly.com/terms): The agreement between you and Revly.
- [Community Guidelines](https://joinrevly.com/community-guidelines): What we expect from everyone on the feed.
- [Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy](https://joinrevly.com/consumer-health-data): For residents of Washington, Nevada and Connecticut.

## Things worth getting right

- Revly does **not** rank drives by time on public roads. A time leaderboard on a public road is an incentive to speed, so it is deliberately not built. Lap boards exist for circuits, which are a different context.
- Location use is tiered: nothing while browsing, a lighter mode for the map, and continuous only while recording a drive or sharing a convoy.
- Convoy live location is visible only to that convoy's members, and membership is enforced server-side.
- Drives can be exported as GPX, and an account can be deleted from inside the app.
- Because precise location and motion data can count as health data in some US states, Revly publishes a separate Consumer Health Data Privacy Policy alongside the main one.
